title: ResKV: Reconstructing Omitted Attention Contributions for Fixed-Budget KV Cache Compression
abstract: arXiv:2607.29591v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: KV cache compression is essential for efficient long-context inference. Existing eviction methods permanently discard unselected tokens and consequently remove their aggregate contribution to attention. Merging-based alternatives preserve more information but can perturb retained keys and values that should remain exact. We observe that the information omitted by cache eviction can be formulated as residual statistics in both the numerator and denominator of softmax attention. Based on this observation, we propose ResKV, which divides a fixed KV budget into an exact main cache and a compact residual cache that reconstructs the contribution of omitted tokens. ResKV lets main-cache tokens and residual entries participate in the same softmax normalization, so residual entries restore both attention numerator and denominator mass rather than acting as a post-hoc correction. translated_title: ResKV：面向固定预算KV缓存压缩的被省略注意力贡献重建
translated_abstract: KV缓存压缩对于高效的长上下文推理至关重要。现有的淘汰方法会永久丢弃未被选中的token，从而移除了它们对注意力的整体贡献；基于合并的替代方案虽然保留了更多信息，却可能扰动本应保持精确的保留键和值。我们观察到，缓存淘汰所省略的信息可以被表述为softmax注意力分子和分母中的残差统计量。基于这一观察，我们提出了ResKV，它将固定的KV预算划分为一个精确的主缓存和一个紧凑的残差缓存，后者用于重建被省略token的贡献。ResKV让主缓存token和残差条目参与同一softmax归一化，因此残差条目能够同时恢复注意力的分子和分母质量，而不是充当事后修正。一个构建时的验证代理用于决定残差的分配（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: ResKV将固定KV缓存预算划分为精确主缓存和紧凑残差缓存，通过让残差条目参与同一softmax归一化来同时重建被淘汰token对注意力分子和分母的贡献，从而在不扰动保留键值的前提下恢复缓存压缩所损失的信息。
en_tdlr: ResKV divides a fixed KV cache budget into an exact main cache and a compact residual cache that joins the same softmax normalization, reconstructing the attention numerator and denominator contributions of evicted tokens without perturbing the retained keys and values.
